correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive perfect-matching algorithms agree on 272 facets; 41,025 independently enumerated matching subsets are checked by recursive extendability and agree with the 30,561-face complex. Every one of 150,720 Hasse incidences passes DAG acyclicity in both toggle orders. Exact oriented Morse boundary 124x91 has 70 unit pivots and zero residual matrix, giving the integral 54S3+21S4 wedge by 3-dimensional Hurewicz and cellular cancellation. Reverse-order integer ranks (80,9) and direct mod-two unreduced Betti numbers independently agree; standalone checker recomputed successfully.

value.rationale: The four-cube is the canonical smallest four-dimensional hypercube and a 4-by-4 toroidal square grid. Its perfect-matching complex is a natural exact topological object with 272 eight-edge facets. The previously undetermined integral homotopy has a mixed-dimensional 54S3+21S4 wedge in strictly subtop dimensions of a pure seven-complex, forcing non-shellability and supplying a substantive benchmark for perfect matching complexes on periodic grids; no arbitrary slice or claimed family theorem.
